title: Recording live in one take; David Lastie's sax solo
summary: He sang and played piano live in one take; David Lastie took the solo and now plays with Frogman Henry.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: I played piano. Did you do everything live? I mean, you'd be playing piano and singing at the same time?
You wouldn't go back and sing? Can I do the vocal play? No. No, I did all that. You didn't do everything live?
Right. How many takes would you? I only did one on, I don't know what I would do. One take. Who takes that sax solo on there?
David Lasty. David Lasty. Yeah. Can I do the vocal play?
No, no. I did all that. You did everything live.
Right. How many takes would you?
I only did one on, I don't know what I'll do.
One take. Who takes that sax solo on that?
He's improved quite a bit since then. Yeah.

I haven't heard him play lately. That's with Frogman Henry now. Yeah. I've heard him about maybe seven, eight months, something like that. I haven't heard him play lately. That's because I know him and I see him quite often. But I haven't heard him play in a little while.
